text.p: HIH Winterthur International Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it expected a stronger result in the second half of calendar 1996 after reporting a 73 percent rise in net profit for the first half.
The insurance group also said it had won an insurance tender with National Australia Bank which is expected to generate A$70 to A$100 million of premium in the first two years.
"We certainly expect a stronger second half," chief executive officer Ray Williams told reporters.
"We are always very much at the whim of the investment markets for the bottom line result but that aside we expect a strong second half," he said.
Williams said the deal with NAB confirms the insurance company's market leadership in the provision of insurance products and services to financial institutions.

"I am delighted with this new relationshp with the National as it will substantially add to our critical mass in this specialised area and enable us to further refine and enhance our service delivery capabilities," Williams said.
Shares in HIH Winterthur, which is controlled by Winterthur Swiss Insurance Co, were steady at A$2.59 at 11.00 a.m. (0100 GMT).
